# tenancy.Unit

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A node of a project's unit tree, typed by an application module (depth 0-6).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.Unit` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `unit` |
| Permission | `core.unit.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ancestorIds` | yes | `none` | Ids of every ancestor unit, root first; length equals depth. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the unit was created (UTC). |  |
| `depth` | yes | `none` | Number of ancestors, 0-6. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the unit. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Display name of the unit. |  |
| `parentUnitId` | yes | `none` | Parent unit; null when the unit sits directly under the project. |  |
| `projectId` | yes | `none` | Project the unit tree belongs to. |  |
| `settings` | yes | `none` | Regional overrides of the unit. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization that owns the unit. |  |
| `type` | yes | `none` | Registered unit type, `<module>.<type>`. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the unit last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Project` via `projectId`
- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Unit` via `parentUnitId`
